SELECT c.region, COUNT(*) AS orders, SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price) AS 
revenue FROM shop.customers c JOIN shop.orders o ON o.customer_id = 
c.id JOIN shop.order_items i ON i.order_id = o.id WHERE c.region = 
'West' GROUP BY c.region
